rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided Gardner 3AA label and notes expansion/zona thinning appropriately, but it overstates confidence in ICM and TE visibility from this single somewhat blurry image and adds features like a well-defined compact ICM that are not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor diagnosis, prior miscarriage, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and cycle context with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to embryo and patient factors, though some adjustments are somewhat subjective and a few assumptions are introduced without direct supporting data.

Mostly aligned on SET and general IVF assessment, but recommendations such as considering assisted hatching, low-dose aspirin, thrombophilia workup after a single miscarriage, and ERA planning are not routinely guideline-supported in this scenario.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggested investigations/interventions may be more aggressive than necessary after only one prior miscarriage.
